**Finding: deviation (high severity) — § 12.4**

§ 12.4 imposes a non-compete on us: for the term plus 24 months, Juniper Ridge may not develop, market, sell or acquire *any* product or service competing with Cobalt, *in any territory*. This is walk-away territory on two independent grounds — post-term duration beyond 12 months and undefined scope — and it has no carve-out for internal development or acquisitions, so it does not even reach the fallback.

It also squarely contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges that Customer "has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."

Redline (validated, ok:true): delete § 12.4 in full, restoring the preferred position, with the narrowed fallback (named competing product, term only, with internal-development and acquisition carve-outs) offered in the comment if Cobalt raises a genuine protection need.
